name: craft
description: Opt-in engineer toolkit, started only by the user. /craft:plan closes every gap of a large scope in rounds of questions and writes a linear activity that a fresh Haiku subagent reviews. /craft:craft executes it one verified item at a time, with ATDD and the clean code principles. /craft:audit audits a repo, /craft:doc writes ARCHITECTURE.md in the arc42 structure, /craft:setup prepares lint with limits, /craft:hook turns a correction into a project hook, /craft:memory keeps project memory. Hooks deny English-less code, missing data-testid, skipped tests, E2E outside a container and unfiltered tests, and run the full suite before a push when the project has no CI.
